rows.name: Bouncing Spell
rows.description: You can direct a failed spell against a different target.

rows.name: Dazing Spell
rows.description: You can daze creatures with the power of your spells.

rows.name: Disruptive Spell
rows.description: Your magical energies cling to enemies, interfering with their spellcasting.

rows.name: Ectoplasmic Spell
rows.description: Your spells breach the gulf between dimensions, sending ghostly emanations into the ether.

rows.name: Elemental Spell
rows.description: You can manipulate the elemental nature of your spells.

rows.name: Elemental Spell (Acid)
rows.description: You can manipulate the elemental nature of your spells.

rows.name: Elemental Spell (Cold)
rows.description: You can manipulate the elemental nature of your spells.

rows.name: Elemental Spell (Electricity)
rows.description: You can manipulate the elemental nature of your spells.

rows.name: Elemental Spell (Fire)
rows.description: You can manipulate the elemental nature of your spells.

rows.name: Focused Spell
rows.description: When you cast a spell that affects more than one creature, one opponent finds it more difficult to resist.

rows.name: Intensified Spell
rows.description: Your spells can go beyond several normal limitations.

rows.name: Lingering Spell
rows.description: You spell clings to existence, slowly fading from the world.

rows.name: Merciful Spell
rows.description: Your damaging spells subdue rather than kill.

rows.name: Persistent Spell
rows.description: You can modify a spell to become more tenacious when its targets resist its effect.

rows.name: Preferred Spell
rows.description: You find it very easy to cast one particular spell.

rows.name: Reach Spell
rows.description: Your spells go farther than normal.

rows.name: Selective Spell
rows.description: Your allies need not fear friendly fire.

rows.name: Sickening Spell
rows.description: You can sicken creatures with your spells.

rows.name: Thundering Spell
rows.description: You can conjure your spells into existence with blaring thunder or fearful shrieks, deafening creatures damaged by their effects.
